# The migraine EP is now available
That's right, four acid tracks (including a revised version of postdrome which was originally released on 909 Day) moving through the disorientation, pain and exhaustion of migraine, where the world narrows, time stretches, and the only way out is to sleep.

  1. prodrome/aura
  2. attack phase
  3. postdrome
  4. sleep it off

You can listen and buy it on Bandcamp here
